name: ferrata_relayer_module
description: Ferrata (prototype): ferrata-relayer as a module: imports the vault's deposit roots on LEZ (ImportRoot under the newest record of the configuration's light client, built and dry-run with the bridge module's code), submits rule (B) checkpoints and finalises them, relays and wraps users' releases for its fee, collects its fees and watches the zone's burns, as a loop under Logos Core or for a given number of rounds
